features.title: Sign in to Ardur
features.summary: Use your server account to sign in. Open password recovery when it is available.

steps.text: Open the sign-in page and find the email form.
Choose password recovery from the sign-in page.

boundaries: Password recovery depends on the server configuration.

troubleshooting.action: Check the connection details and try again.
